title: Curia — The personal media company, shaped by your curiosity.
excerpt: Your saves, read across and turned into beautifully produced audio — drawn entirely from your curated sources.
content_html:
curia
How it works Begin listening→

Intelligent audio

shaped by your curiosity

How it works

A private space where your curiosity
takes shape.

A space that exists
for no one else.

i. — Save

You save what catches you.

A Substack piece, a Reddit thread, a friend's link. The act stays familiar.

ii. — Pattern

We connect the dots.

Six articles on sleep. We read across them, find the thread, and build from it.

iii. — Show

A show arrives.

A produced audio show, made entirely from what you saved.

Saved for later

Every bookmark is a promise
you broke to yourself.

The save was the action. But the loop never closed.

A show, in the open

"The neuroscience says your phone is winning. The productivity gurus say you are. Both are selling something."

— Episode 12 · a week of your saves

19 min · 3 chapters · Ready when you are

Curia Show · 12

Why you can't focus, and who profits from it.

A show built from a week of your saves.

You didn't know those saves were connected. Curia did.

The things you saved
were never wasted.

Feed your mind. Not just fill your time.

Stay updated

You're in. We'll keep you posted.

built by the curious, for the curious.

Bhabani ex-founder, Evy(acquired)

Arihant ex Sentient Labs, Expedia

Aditya ex Flash AI, NoBroker

Friends since IIT Guwahati, bonded by a shared obsession with technology and culture.

The internet we grew up with seemed like a fun adventure, wherever curiosity led you. Then attention became the product.

curia is our attempt at fixing that.
